message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: Defendant Linghu stole an electric bike (value 2300 yuan) from He. He concealed it, then sold to Jiang for 600 yuan. Jiang knew it was stolen property and bought it. So crimes: For Linghu: theft (盗窃罪). Since value 2300 yuan, "数额较大" qualifies as theft. Possibly also "非法占有" but theft covers. Could also be "盗窃罪" only. For Jiang: "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪" (concealing/receiving stolen property). The fact says Jiang "明知是犯罪所得赃物而予以收购". That's the crime of "收购、窝藏、转移、隐匿盗窃、抢劫、诈骗、敲诈勒索等犯罪的财物罪" (Article 276 of Criminal Law). The name is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪". So we list both: 盗窃罪;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪.

We must output in format: [罪名]盗窃罪;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪<eoa>
